details.publicNotes:
Also known as mine serpents or saboteur drakes, coal drakes are dangerous predators who tend to inhabit cavernous environments, making them a nuisance for mining crews who overlap their territory. These wily, serpentine creatures employ many hunting tactics to ambush and disorient their prey for an easy kill. One of their favored tactics involves deliberately causing cave-ins by using their explosive breath.

Coal drakes are notoriously territorial. To ward off any competition, they mark their territory with blasts of coal dust. Those wishing to avoid an encounter with such a beast had best keep a keen eye out for any residue from these blasts and avoid igniting it. The resulting explosions are not only hazardous but also inevitably draw the coal drake's ire.

Despite their otherwise solitary nature, coal drakes mate for life, and a mating pair of drakes is often more open to negotiation than a singular coal drake would be. There are even records of a mating pair of coal drakes engaging in regular bartering, offering the use of their territory for mining in exchange for food and sanctuary.

Weapons of War

Though occasionally used as mounts, coal drakes raised in captivity are frequently employed as demolitionists. Teams of sappers train the drakes to detonate the foundations of enemy fortifications or seek out and destroy infrastructure such as bridges, dams, or roads. More rarely, coal drakes can also serve constructive purposes, such as enlarging mine shafts or paving the path for mountain passes essential to long-distance trade, but being difficult to control, their powers are usually better served through random destruction.

description.value: The coal drake's lithe form allows them to traverse caves and tunnels with ease. The coal drake can move through a gap at least 2 feet wide without Squeezing and can Squeeze through a gap at least 1 foot wide.

A creature hit by the coal drake's tail Strikes must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save; the creature is then temporarily immune to flint sparks for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} and dazzled for 1 minute.

The coal drake spews forth a billowing cloud of coal dust in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20]. All creatures within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within the cloud. The cloud persists for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds}, during which time the coal drake can't use their Coaldust Breath again. If an open flame enters the cloud, or if any attack or effect with the fire trait occurs within it (such as the coal drake's tail Strike), the cloud ignites, dealing @Damage[5d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature within it (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). The cloud then dissipates prematurely, but this explosion doesn't allow the coal drake to recover the use of Coaldust Breath more quickly.
The coal drake makes two Fangs Strikes and one Tail Strike in any order.

Frequency three times per day

Effect The coal drake Strides, Flies, or Climbs twice.
